title: Managed Backup: negotiated pricing
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines negotiated pricing.

## Tier basis

**Permission for approved negotiated pricing.** Whether an approved signed unit-rate amendment overrides the standard primary rate; boolean.

| Contract tier | Permission for approved negotiated pricing |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | Yes |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | Yes |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | Yes |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | Yes |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | Yes |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | Yes |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, permission for approved negotiated pricing is Yes.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, permission for approved negotiated pricing stays the same.
